1.note: Printed 90a; the saying "the Torah spoke in hyperbole" is at Hullin 90b.

2.note: Printed אחד ("one"); the Yerushalmi reads לדבר אחר ("another matter"); rendered by the sense.

3.note: Printed chapter 3; the saying of R. Yoḥanan is in Yerushalmi Pe'ah 2:4 (2:6 in some editions).

4.note: Yerushalmi Megillah has only four chapters; the saying is in Yerushalmi Megillah 1:5 (70d). Kept as printed.

5.note: Chapter number hard to read in the scan (ז or ו); OCR has פ"ו.

6.note: Reference to Jellinek's sermons as printed, with no title or page; kept as given.

7.note: Printed 17, 10; the quoted words 'thou shalt not turn aside ... to the right hand, nor to the left' are Deuteronomy 17:11.

8.note: Printed so; Ptolemy's taking of Jerusalem on the Sabbath is Antiquities 12.1.1 ('ח"ב' is perhaps the volume of the edition used).

9.note: Pompey's capture of Jerusalem is in Antiquities 14.4; kept as printed.

10.note: Image reads י"ח.; Shammai's exposition 'until it fall, even on the Sabbath' is in Shabbat 19a.

11.note: Image reads פ"ט ה"ב; the passage is in Yerushalmi Sanhedrin 4:2. Kept as printed.

12.note: The saying about Elijah is Eduyot 8:7; kept as printed.

13.note: Printed Shimon; the commentator on Zera'im and Tohorot is R. Samson (Shimshon) of Sens.

14.note: The baraita of R. Ilai is Tosefta Pe'ah 3:2; kept as printed.

15.note: Printed thus (Megillah has four chapters); the passage on the final letters is Yerushalmi Megillah 1:9, as cited just above.

16.note: Word in parentheses unclear in the scan (שינתה / שנתה); rendered by the sense of Niddah 45a (a girl who had intercourse).

17.note: The passage on mikra soferim etc. is Nedarim 37b; the scan shows a point (side a). Kept as printed.

18.note: Scan unclear (OCR פ"נ ח"נ); the passage on the Ammonite woman is Yerushalmi Yevamot 8:3.

19.note: The scan shows מ"ב (possibly מ"ג); "in truth they said" is in Mishnah Shabbat 1:3.
